title: ANGLER: Verifier-Grounded Benchmarking with an Adaptive Attacker for Web Agents
why: REEF+ANGLER: executable verifier-grounded web-agent red-team bench with adaptive near-miss attack evolution on live sites.
mechanism: REEF: 9 verifier-grounded AutoWebWorld sites with state-based success checks for benign+malicious objectives (5 attack types); ANGLER adaptively mutates attacks from near-miss rollout feedback instead of fixed attack sets.
